name: Karma
source:
"The best people, Princess, look beautiful. The way you look outside has to match what you have inside."

A young man that carries himself with poise and dignity, though he has a flair for the dramatic. He is a secretive person who has many quirky yet sophisticated habits.

Occasionally cross dresses, insisting it is one of the only ways to stop the effects of his curse. He has only divulged information about his curse to a select few.

[From [url=http://dicesuki.tumblr.com/post/147859949560/the-plot-summary-and-character-bios-are-here-what]official[/url] [url=http://dicesuki.tumblr.com/post/148343332775/hi-everyone-heres-more-information-about-the]blog[/url]]

[spoiler]His real full name is Klaude Aidric Renaldi Mattheus Almonte.[/spoiler]
